_comment: Single source of truth for every page's SEO/social meta tags. Edit a value here, then run scripts/sync-seo-meta.ps1 (or double-click scripts/update-seo.bat) to regenerate the actual <title>/<meta> tags in each page's HTML — social crawlers (Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn, Slack...) read raw HTML only, no JavaScript, so these have to be static tags baked into each file, not something set at runtime. That's also why og: and twitter: exist as separate tags at all despite carrying the same values — this file (and the script) is what keeps them in sync so you only ever type a title/description once. See reference/seo-metadata.md.
